name: board-team-of-5-30rft-6-each
rawText:
A. BODY ARMOR - Shoulders
2 sets:
10-12 Banded Scapular Push-up
(slow)
10/10 Seated Shoulder External Rotation
(elbow on knee)
~45/45 sec Sleeper (CR) Stretch

B. STRENGTH (press)
4 sets:
4 Strict Press @85-90% (work from the
floor)
4 Chin-up @0-1 R.I.R

C. METCON (Intervals)
In teams of 5, I go you go:
30 RFT (6 each):
8/10 Calories Echo Bike (30 sec time
limit)
6 Touch-and-Go Clean and Jerk @35/50kg

⊲ 22 minutes T.C. ▷
* Once a team member gets off the
bike, the other may start.
